div.div: رَاشٍ The giver of a رِشْوَة [or bribe]: hence the trad., لَعَنَ ٱللّٰهُ الرَّاشِىَ وَالمُرْتَشِىَ وَالرَّائِشَ, i. e. [May God curse] the giver of a رِشْوَة, who aids another to do what is wrong, and the receiver thereof, and him who is agent between them two, demanding more for this or less for this. (IAth, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
